source: HumanKind business_profiles.outreach_rules (edited 2026-08-21) + outreach_doctrine HARD rows (platform scope, left in place); hk-legacy-cleanup-v1 Stage 1. Consumed by hkos-data-foundation-v1 lint_draft.

banned_patterns.rule: No pressure or guilt in the subject line or body.
No curiosity-bait subject lines; the subject is 'HumanKind x [Company] - [clear descriptor]'.
No invented prospect details - only what research surfaced.
Never imply a prior meeting, call or conversation that is not in the inputs.
No em dashes; plain hyphens only.
No generic 'sponsor a challenge' ask - the challenge or reward concept must be specific to the prospect's product, audience or values.
A generic contact form gets one form-sized message, never a multi-touch sequence.
The close is a soft, low-friction CTA - suggest a 15-minute call (email) or a quick chat (LinkedIn), never demand one.
Creator outreach is never a sponsorship deck - one short, direct message understandable in seconds.
The intro names the 3 most relevant pillars only, never all five.

pillars_rule: Name only the 3 most relevant of the five pillars (fitness, community, mindfulness, sustainability, learning) in the intro - never all five.
ask_rule: Calibrate the ask to the commitment level: ask directly for a reward or raffle listing; propose a short 15-minute call for a sponsored challenge; with larger retailers lead with the challenge idea and ask for the call only after a positive reply. Always suggest, never demand.
stats_rule: Member and completion counts come from hk_settings, never from carried text; 1,000+ / 4,000+ and 1,100+ / 5,000+ are stale August 2026 figures.
